summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; delegates to print with emoji, markup, and crop off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, highlight defaulting to True). Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging, and an "Added Console.out" bullet under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md. Nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run, so the changes are unverified.
